annotations.title: Read an RSS or Atom feed

description: Read a public RSS 2.0, RSS 1.0 or Atom feed and get the feed title, link and description plus its newest items: title, link, date (ISO 8601), short plain-text summary, author and id. Up to 50 items, feeds up to 2 MB. Lenient with real-world feeds; a page that is not a feed returns 422, uncharged. Use to follow news, blogs, release notes or podcasts without scraping pages. Example: url=https://github.blog/feed/, limit=10. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
